question: What conduct should an even-minded practitioner abandon through sustained practice?
premises: Practice leads to an even mind
Village duty is named as something to abandon
The abandonment is prescribed as a rule
inference: Through practice, one who becomes even-minded should abandon village duty.
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer broadly to conventional social obligations
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the duties of village life.
